commandHelpSkillshelfSummary: Opens the Skill Shelf panel (The Skill Shelf ADR, 2026-09-20): install skills from the SKR reference with a signed provenance receipt, uninstall only what the shelf signed. Snapshot-first - the cached shelf opens instantly; --reload rebuilds it from the SKR first.
commandHelpSkillshelfParamReload: Optional flag: rebuild the shelf snapshot from skills-reff.md before the panel opens (fresh numbering, fresh installed state). Without it the cached snapshot is used as-is.
commandHelpSkillshelfExampleBare: The shelf panel opens (or comes forward if already open) with the cached snapshot.
commandHelpSkillshelfExampleReload: Re-reads the SKR and rebuilds the snapshot, then opens the shelf.
skillsShelfRescan: Installed - it appears in the composer's skill menu after the host rescans its catalog.
skillsVoiceDshJumpPrepareFix: Prepares the local DSH checkout for a version jump: state backup, dependency audit, and a go/no-go checklist.
skillsVoiceDsiAdr: Write, review, or finish a DSI architectural decision record with the five-site depth standard: numbered decisions, named rejections, diagrams.
skillsVoiceDsiI18nMigrate: Migrate UI copy into the translation catalogs: the t(m.x) reactive seat, en/zh/id/es catalog triples, and the parity gates.
skillsVoiceDsiOvSetup: Diagnose and set up OpenViking memory for DeepSeek Harness: plugin, skill, server, config, and verification.
skillsVoiceDsiRelease: Analyze a DSH release/tag jump for DeepSeek Insight impact: the three touchpoints, matchers, and the KB release note verdict.
skillsVoiceDsiSpcheck: Verify feature-spec coherence: trace facts across Karpathy context, PRD, and Tasks to catch missing branches before execution.
skillsVoiceDsiSpec: Analyze a feature request via the Karpathy method and generate a PRD + Tasks spec with execution checklists.
skillsVoiceDsiSync: Mirror DeepSeek Insight into its GitHub-ready target: resync, commit, push, and skip cleanly when nothing changed.
skillsVoiceDsiTask: Execute implementation tasks from a Karpathy context + tasks document: visible checklists, gates, and wave discipline.
terminalSessionCap: Session cap reached — close a terminal to open another.
terminalDisabled: Terminal is disabled — enable it in settings (terminal.enabled).
editedFilesGone: Files were edited this turn — counts are no longer available
pluginRackApplying: Applying — the floor will come back shortly.
pluginRackEmpty: No plugins on the rack yet — add a line to plugins-reff.md.
commandHelpPluginrackSummary: Opens the Plugin Rack panel (The Plugin Rack ADR, 2026-09-27): install and uninstall dsh plugins from the plugins reference. Every apply ends with the DSH restart chain - the floor bounces and the page re-attaches.
commandHelpPluginrackParamReload: Force a snapshot rebuild from plugins-reff.md before the panel opens. Without it the cached rack snapshot is used as-is.
commandHelpPluginrackExampleBare: Opens the rack - install or uninstall with one click per row.
commandHelpPluginrackExampleReload: Rebuilds the rack snapshot first (fresh numbering, fresh installed flags).
pluginRackInstallEmpty: Everything on the rack is installed.
pluginRackUninstallEmpty: Nothing installed yet - install a plugin from the install tab.
workspaceFileStale: Saved — refresh to confirm the written file
